abstract: The human reproductive / gonadal-endocrine (HPG) axis derived on the VP Theory jammed-vacuum substrate. A single bistable R19 switch and a single FitzHugh-Nagumo relaxation oscillator generate every reproductive rhythm: organ emergence in measured-gamma order, the GnRH pulse generator (frequency-coded LH/FSH), the menstrual and spermatogenic relaxation cycles, the discontinuous ovulatory surge, and puberty as a spinodal crossing. One sex-hormone drive produces two opposite failure modes -- an oscillator disease and a barrier-lowered oncogenic switch -- and one lever, temporal pattern, runs the therapy map (pulsatile GnRH, BAT, the hCG trigger). Deterministic and honestly graded; not clinical advice.

chapters.one_liner: The reproductive / gonadal-endocrine axis on a jammed-vacuum substrate: one R19 switch and one FHN oscillator give one drive, two failure modes, one temporal-pattern lever.
chapters.title: Scope and the jammed-vacuum substrate

chapters.one_liner: Germline, testis, ovary and reproductive tract emerge on the substrate from measured promoter (DAZL, SOX9, FOXL2, WT1); developmental order is argsort( ).
chapters.title: Organ emergence from measured master-gene γ

chapters.one_liner: T1: the hypothalamic GnRH pulse generator as the shared FHN relaxation oscillator; pulse frequency decodes to LH/FSH balance as a monotone function of the recovery timescale.
chapters.title: GnRH pulse generator (T1)

chapters.one_liner: T2: the menstrual cycle as the slowest relaxation oscillator in the package; the rise/fall timing asymmetry is far from 1.0, confirming relaxation (not sinusoidal) dynamics.
chapters.title: Menstrual cycle as a relaxation oscillator (T2)

chapters.one_liner: T3: oestrogen feedback as a bistable R19 switch negative feedback flips discontinuously to the positive-feedback LH surge at the spinodal, with hysteresis.
chapters.title: Oestrogen feedback switch & LH surge (T3)

chapters.one_liner: T4: the seminiferous (spermatogenic) cycle as a third relaxation clock from the same substrate, intermediate between the GnRH pulse and the menstrual cycle; the three periods order correctly.
chapters.title: Spermatogenic cycle (T4)

chapters.one_liner: T5: puberty as a discontinuous spinodal crossing the juvenile-paused GnRH oscillator switches ON in a single step as a slow maturation drive passes the spinodal.
chapters.title: Puberty onset as a spinodal crossing (T5)

chapters.one_liner: Hormone-driven cancer as Kramers escape over an R19 barrier a sustained hormone drive lowers; the dose-response shape is universal in (max spread 0.0). Breast, prostate, cervical shapes.
chapters.title: Hormone-driven cancer dose-response

chapters.one_liner: The temporal pattern of a hormone drive pulsatile vs continuous, cycling vs sustained is a control axis separate from level; it retrodicts pulsatile-GnRH, depot agonists and BAT.
chapters.title: Temporal pattern as a therapeutic lever

chapters.one_liner: Eight common HPG disorders mapped to one substrate; PCOS and hypothalamic amenorrhoea are opposite ends of one pulse-frequency axis; menopause is irreversible latch loss. Retrodictions and hypotheses.
chapters.title: HPG disease mechanisms & hypotheses

chapters.one_liner: The germ cell on the same substrate: meiosis as one replication and two ordered divisions, non-identical gametes from assortment and interference-spaced recombination, the sperm flagellum as the fast relaxation oscillator and the egg as a held switch.
chapters.title: The gamete itself: meiosis, motility and the egg

chapters.one_liner: The embryo on the same substrate: the sperm (oscillator) meets the egg (held switch) and flips it, two haploids fuse to a unique diploid genome, cleavage and ZGA follow, and the gene-clock argsort(spinodal(gamma)) lays out the body plan of a fetus.
chapters.title: The embryo: fertilisation to fetus

chapters.one_liner: Conception is an AND of substrate operations; infertility is an operation past a spinodal (categorical), subfertility is one near a threshold (a finite Kramers rate per cycle).
chapters.title: Infertility and subfertility: past a spinodal vs near a threshold

chapters.one_liner: Mammalian sex is the SOX9 FOXL2 bistable switch; Mendel is the same switch untilted; a drive gene tilts it, and a sex-chromosome driver skews the offspring sex ratio.
chapters.title: Sex determination and sex-ratio distortion: tilting a fair coin

headline_results: Four reproductive organs emerge in measured-gamma order (germline -> testis -> ovary -> tract).
One spinodal h_sp = 0.3849 makes every fate-flip and the ovulatory surge discontinuous.
The GnRH generator fires 62 pulses; pulse frequency alone codes LH vs FSH.
Menstrual (1133.7) and spermatogenic (656.5) cycles are one oscillator at two recovery speeds.
Sustained sex-hormone drive raises modelled breast-cancer RR to 5.29 (saturating).
Cycling androgen (BAT) amplifies resistant-clone stress 13.6x over continuous suppression.
Infertility = an operation past a spinodal (per-cycle p=0); subfertility = a near-threshold Kramers rate one drive nudge moves 1.56x.
Sex is the SOX9<->FOXL2 bistable; Mendel is it untilted (0.50), a drive tilts it, and a sex-chromosome driver skews offspring sex (X-shredder 1.00 male).
title: Reproductive and Gonadal-Endocrine Emergence: the HPG Oscillator, the Menstrual Cycle, and Hormone-Driven Cancer
